name: Kaiser Camping Outdoor Resort
beschreibung: The Kaiser Camping Outdoor Resort is located in Bad Feilnbach in the federal state of Tirol, in the region of the Kaisergebirges. The surroundings are characterized by alpine nature and the rock faces of the Wilden Kaisers. From the campsite, the ski areas of Skiwelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental as well as hiking trails into the mountains are accessible. The facility has pitches for motorhomes and tents as well as rental accommodations such as mobile homes. The infrastructure includes sanitary facilities, a dining area, and a small shop for daily needs. The site serves as a starting point for active holidaymakers who want to explore the surrounding mountains and valleys.
